name: Lying Single-Arm Cable Extension
description: A unilateral triceps isolation exercise performed lying on a bench with a low cable pulley. One arm extends the cable attachment overhead while the other rests on the torso. This allows independent training of each tricep head.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Lying Single-Arm Cable Extension in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Lying Single-Arm Cable Extension.
steps: Step 1: Lie on bench with head near low cable pulley. Grasp single handle.
Step 2: Raise arm overhead, upper arm perpendicular to floor.
Step 3: Bend elbow to lower handle behind head, feeling tricep stretch.
Step 4: Extend arm back to starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
common_mistakes: Using shoulder to assist the movement
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
